newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone says has received no approaches.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone says has received no approaches.

text.p: Vodafone Plc said on Thursday it had received no takeover approaches.
It was reponding to a question from Reuters after a burst of activity in its options sparked a bout of bid speculation.
A spokesman for the mobile phone company said: "We can categorically say we have had no approaches whatsoever."
Earlier the stock leapt amid a burst of options activity, with stock market and options specialists saying there was vague market talk of a possible German bid.

By 1238 GMT the stock had retreated from its early 21-1/2p gain to be up just 7p at 285. Trading in the stock was heavy with volume reaching 12.3 million shares, making it the most active stock in the FTSE 100 index.

Vodafone shares have risen sharply in recent weeks, propelled by positive comment from brokerages including Merrill Lynch and as incoming chief executive Chris Gent kicked off a round of investor presentations in the United States.
